info.title: Talibon Municipal API
info.description: Send X-API-Version: 1 (default when omitted). Legacy auth and administration routes return 410. Staff operations use Better Auth HttpOnly cookies and MFA. Errors contain success, statusCode, error, message, timestamp and requestId. Checked-in scope: retained public content/search/catalog contracts, R2 staff authentication and private photo/document media. Other APIs remain in the live document.
